simplified_takeaways: Returns are strong, but construction costs are flagged as low—final numbers may shift.
QIA-Brookfield partnership makes financing fast and reliable if a government anchor is secured.
Permitting and grid connection must be done at the same time to avoid long delays.
Most of the first phase will be leased to a single government tenant—this is both a strength and a risk.
Transformer and hardware supply chains are the main schedule risks.
explainability.why_this_recommendation: We recommend proceeding with a 50 MW powered shell in Qatar, using a hybrid cooling system and targeting a sovereign anchor tenant, because this approach is supported by recent Equinix and Digital Realty filings showing strong returns for similar assets, and by the QIA-Brookfield partnership which de-risks financing. The main risks are construction cost reconciliation and supply chain delays, but the scarcity of regional capacity and the ability to secure a long-term government lease make this a high-confidence, financeable project.

signals.title: QIA-Brookfield $20B AI infra partnership — lowest-friction capital path for Qatar assets
signals.implication: A Qatar powered-shell or JV with a signed hyperscaler or sovereign anchor is immediately financeable via the QIA-Brookfield vehicle — likely at 60–65% LTV, 5.5–7% exit cap rate (comp: datapoint dlr_exit_cap_rate). This eliminates 6–12 months of capital-raise friction vs approaching general infra funds.

signals.title: KAHRAMAA 50 MW grid connection: 24-month process — must run in parallel, not series
signals.implication: Sequencing KAHRAMAA application after QFZA permit adds 24 months to the critical path — a developer error that is responsible for the majority of Qatar DC delays. Parallel processing (KAHRAMAA + QFZA simultaneously) delivers both approvals by mid-2027 for a Q3 2025 submission. Serial sequencing slips energisation to 2029.

signals.title: Top-4 hyperscalers at $210B/yr capex — third-party supply demand is structural, not cyclical
signals.implication: A Qatar powered-shell or JV at 50–200 MW with Tier III+ and delivery within 30 months of LOI is directly financeable. Global DC wholesale vacancy is at 3%; demand is outpacing supply in every constrained market.

signals.title: DC wholesale rents +12% YoY, global vacancy at 3% — favourable pricing for new assets
